column1: One row per question. Questions with the same Step appear together on one screen (Step heading is that screen's heading). Input type: Single = choose one; Multi = select all that apply. Result role: Classification = the stage badge (one question only); Signal = a tile on the result; None = not shown as a tile. Helper text is internal.

column4: Which statement best describes how your organization manages learning today?
column5: A directional, self-reported stage. It adjusts how much process and governance guidance the result gives. It is never inferred from team size, sourcing or delivery format.
column6: How your organization manages learning today.

column4: What is your main L&D challenge right now?
column5: Chooses the first priority, the title and the 30-day action.
column6: The challenge that matters most right now.

column4: Which learning delivery methods do you currently use?
column5: Multiple selections. Tailors the delivery advice; mixed delivery gets its own guidance.
column6: The delivery methods you use today.

column4: How many people are in your internal L&D team?
column5: Tailors workload advice. Ranges do not overlap: 0, 1-5, 6-15, 16+.
column6: The size of your team and how work gets done.

column4: How is your learning work delivered?
column5: Tailors coordination advice. Independent of team size: any combination is valid.

column4: What would you most like to improve over the next 6–12 months?
column5: Chooses the second priority and the 90-day action. Outcome only; never presupposes buying services.
column6: What you want to improve over the next year.
